feeds.title: Zartman Cruising
feeds.description: We are the Zartman family: Ben & Danielle, and our three girls, Antigone, Emily, and Damaris. We created this website/blog to chronicle our sailing adventures on Ganymede, a home-finished 31-foot gaff-rigged cutter. Follow our journey.

feeds.title: Sailing Totem Blog
feeds.description: Cruising the world's oceans as a family since 2008; circumnavigators sharing our travel adventures afloat and ashore.

feeds.title: The Foster Journey Blog
feeds.description: This is the story of a family from Texas seeking to go off-grid and travel the oceans on a sailboat. In 2019, the Fosters sold their house, tried to build an online business, and then bought a sailboat in 2020 to begin travelling on the oceans.

feeds.title: A Family Afloat
feeds.description: A Mom, 3 amazing kids (currently 17, 12, and 7), and an amazing Dad/Captain. We are currently intending to sail our boat around the world.

feeds.title: BioTrek Sailing Travel Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our website and sailing blog where we will let family and friends know about our whereabouts, our boat, and our long-distance voyages.

feeds.title: Dreamtime Sail
feeds.description: Dreamtime Sail, a sailing blog of Australians Rob & Karen who sail their 42' Ketch 'Our Dreamtime' where ever the wind takes them.

feeds.title: UBI
feeds.description: A family of five, a sailboat, a world. We came to Portland, Oregon from Belgium and France with two pieces of luggage, thinking we'd only stay a few years. We loved this area and stayed twelve years in beautiful Oregon, and meanwhile had three kids, two cars, and one house. In Spring 2018 and after 3 years of preparation, we sold everything, and have been living on Ubi full time starting July 5th, 2018.
